incident: Employee attendance PDF export crashes because of an unsupported font rendering configuration.
root_cause: The PDF generator uses an unsupported font.
resolution: Replace the unsupported font with the validated font profile.
prevention: Add PDF rendering regression tests for supported fonts.
evidence: The font configuration was confirmed as the root cause.

incident: A wildlife image classification service crashes because the uploaded image has an unsupported TIFF compression format.
root_cause: The image processing component does not support the TIFF compression format used by the uploaded file.
resolution: Convert the TIFF image to a supported compression format before classification.
prevention: Validate supported TIFF compression formats during upload and add image-format regression tests.
evidence: Developer reproduced the TIFF compression failure.
The unsupported compression format was confirmed as the cause.
